source.name: Most frequent words: Brazilian Portuguese (OpenSubtitles pt-BR, English Wiktionary)
source.notes:
The 6,000 most frequent Brazilian Portuguese words, in frequency order.
Frequency: OpenSubtitles 2018 Brazilian Portuguese word counts (hermitdave/FrequencyWords pt_br, CC BY-SA 4.0), the largest open frequency list that is specifically Brazilian.
Lemmatization: michmech/lemmatization-lists Portuguese (ODbL 1.0) plus Wiktionary headwords and form-of entries
Disambiguation: UD Portuguese Porttinari treebank of Brazilian news (CC BY-SA 4.0), used only to split ambiguous forms
Definitions and parts of speech: English Wiktionary, via the Wiktextract/Kaikki.org extraction in Vuizur/Wiktionary-Dictionaries (2022–23 snapshot; CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL)
Conjugation tables: UniMorph Portuguese (unimorph/por, from English Wiktionary; CC BY-SA 3.0) and the verbecc templates (bretttolbert/verbecc, GPL-2.0-or-later), compared cell by cell; Brazilian spelling of the 1990 Orthographic Agreement; imperatives derived from the present tenses; compound tenses are ter + participle.
Example sentences: Tatoeba (CC-BY-2.0-FR); UD Portuguese Porttinari (CC-BY-SA-4.0); AI-written (Claude) (AI-generated, not checked by a native speaker); the source of every sentence is listed in pt-sentence-credits.tsv.
See docs/VOCABULARY_SOURCES.md for licences and attribution.
